messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Bengali, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Bengali line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
আমি একটু বিশ্রাম নেওয়ার পরে আমার ক্লান্ত দেহ, আমি আবার মরুভূমির ঢাল বরাবর পথ নিলাম, যাতে দৃঢ় পা সর্বদা নিচেরটি ছিল।

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑by‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|------------------|--------| | Poi | temporal adverb “after” | পরে | after | OK | | ch’èi | 1st‑person pronoun “I” | আমি | I | OK | | posato | verb “rested” (perfect) | বিশ্রাম নেওয়ার | (to) rest | OK | | un | indefinite article/ numeral “a” | – | – | **UNNECESSARY** | | poco | adverb “little” | একটু | a little | OK | | il | definite article “the” | – | – | **UNNECESSARY** | | corpo | noun “body” | দেহ | body | OK | | lasso | adjective “weary” | ক্লান্ত | weary | OK | | ripresi | verb “resumed / took” | নিলাম | took / resumed | OK | | via | noun “way, path” | পথ | way | OK | | per | preposition “along” | বরাবর | along | OK | | la | definite article “the” | – | – | **UNNECESSARY** | | piaggia | noun “slope” | ঢাল | slope | OK | | diserta | adjective “desert (empty)” | মরুভূমির | desert (of desert) | OK | | sì | adverb/conj “so (that)” | যাতে | so that | OK | | che | conjunction “that” (result clause) | যাতে* | that (as part of “so that”) | OK | | ’l | definite article “the” | – | – | **UNNECESSARY** | | piè | noun “foot” | পা | foot | OK | | fermo | adjective “firm” | দৃঢ় | firm | OK | | sempre | adverb “always” | সর্বদা | always | OK | | era | verb “was” (imperfect) | ছিল | was | OK | | ’l | definite article “the” | – | – | **UNNECESSARY** | | più | comparative marker “more” (forms “lower”) | নিচেরটি | lower | OK | | basso | adjective “low” (comparative) | নিচেরটি | lower | OK |
\*The Bengali conjunctive “যাতে” simultaneously conveys the meaning of both **sì** and **che**; therefore **che** is considered covered and marked **OK**.
---
### Items flagged
- **UNNECESSARY**: *un, il, la, ’l (three occurrences)* – Italian articles/indefinite numeral that have no direct counterpart in Bengali and are naturally omitted.
No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** issues were detected in the translation.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Bengali script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Bengali text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).
